REVISEThe numerical  $V$ -receipt and the forced-next-support rotor exclusion are correct for the stated even parameters, but the NEW-event proof is incomplete as written. The concrete defect is in the newly full three-owner tile  $(22,6)$ : two old directed events are present there, while the text names only one of them.1. The source charges and  $V$ -charge are correctUsing the supplied independent_source constructor: $R=U(32,10,g+2)$  has
$$\operatorname{matching}(R)=\frac g2+37,\qquad
\operatorname{endpointTiles}(R)=\frac g2+22,\qquad
\operatorname{supportsInside}(R)=\frac g2+6,$$
hence
$$\operatorname{charge}(R)
=\left(\frac g2+37\right)+\left(\frac g2+6\right)
 -2\left(\frac g2+22\right)=-1.$$
 $T=U(6,4,g)$  has
$$\operatorname{matching}(T)=\frac g2+7,\qquad
\operatorname{endpointTiles}(T)=\frac g2+8,\qquad
\operatorname{supportsInside}(T)=\frac g2+4,$$
hence
$$\operatorname{charge}(T)=-5.$$
 $W=U(2g+20,4,40)$  has
$$\operatorname{matching}(W)=2g+41,\qquad
\operatorname{endpointTiles}(W)=g+32,\qquad
\operatorname{supportsInside}(W)=22,$$
hence
$$\operatorname{charge}(W)=-1.$$
For  $V=U(6,4,h+8)$  with the stated chart:the five bar edges, two near-leg edges, and  $(h+8)/2$  far-leg edges give
$$\operatorname{matching}(V)=5+2+\frac{h+8}{2}
=\frac h2+11;$$
its endpoint-tile footprint consists of four bar tiles, two additional near-leg tiles, and  $(h+8)/2$  additional far-leg tiles:
$$\operatorname{endpointTiles}(V)
=4+2+\frac{h+8}{2}
=\frac h2+10;$$
exactly four axial/bar-end supports, two even near-leg lateral supports, and  $(h+8)/2$  even far-leg lateral supports lie inside that footprint:
$$\operatorname{supportsInside}(V)
=4+2+\frac{h+8}{2}
=\frac h2+10.$$
Therefore
$$\operatorname{charge}(V)
=\left(\frac h2+11\right)+\left(\frac h2+10\right)
 -2\left(\frac h2+10\right)=1.$$
Thus  $V$  contributes one positive-owner indicator and no new negative mass.2. The NEW full-tile set and the NEW event set are correctThe relevant old repair is
$$P_0=U(h+12,10,4)$$
with chart  $(23+r,h+13-c)$ . Its row-23 bar occupies columns  $1,\ldots,h+12$ .The  $V$  far leg occupies row  $22$ , columns  $7,\ldots,h+15$ . The old  $W$  far leg ends at column  $6$ , so the only newly completed mixed full tiles have top-left corners
$$(22,c),\qquad c=6,8,\ldots,h+10.$$
There are
$$\frac h2+3$$
such tiles. The tile at  $c=h+12$  is not full because its lower-right cell  $(23,h+13)$  is absent; that point is the later forced support  $q$ .The NEW directed events are indeed
$$P_0:(23,c)\longrightarrow V:(22,c),
\qquad c=7,\ldots,h+12,$$
giving  $h+6$  events, and
$$V:(22,c)\longrightarrow P_0:(23,c),
\qquad c=8,10,\ldots,h+12,$$
giving  $h/2+3$  events. The odd-column downward directions are excluded by the immutable V lateral supports.Consequently, conditional on the pre- $V$  union being an admissible endpoint-disjoint union,
$$\Delta\Phi(V\mid H_3+R+T+W)
=
1+2\left(\frac h2+3\right)
-\left(\frac{3h}{2}+9\right)
=
-\frac h2-2.$$
Combining this with the preceding gain  $4$  from  $R,T$  and the  $-3$  marginal from  $W$  gives
$$\Phi(H_3+R+T+W+V)-\Phi(H_3)
=
4-3-\frac h2-2
=
-\frac h2-1.$$
So the claimed unbounded debit is numerically correct.3. The concrete bookkeeping gap: tile  $(22,6)$  already has two old eventsBefore  $V$  is added, the tile with top-left corner  $(22,6)$  is not full because  $(22,7)$  is absent. Nevertheless, the event inventory counts directed same-tile endpoint adjacencies independently of whether the tile is full.Before  $V$ , that tile already contains
$$P_0:(23,6)\longrightarrow W:(22,6)$$
and also
$$W:(22,6)\longrightarrow P_0:(23,6).$$
The second event is allowed:  $W:(22,6)$ 's downward target  $(23,6)$  is not one of  $W$ 's immutable supports. Under the W chart, column  $6$  corresponds to the even local far-leg row  $40$ ; the downward supports occur at the odd local rows.After adding  $V$ , the new tile  $(22,6)$  contains
$$W:(22,6),\quad V:(22,7),\quad
P_0:(23,6),\quad P_0:(23,7).$$
The horizontal  $W\leftrightarrow V$  directions are support-excluded by the W and V axial supports. The  $V:(22,7)\to P_0:(23,7)$  direction is excluded by V's odd-column lateral support. The only new event in that tile is therefore
$$P_0:(23,7)\longrightarrow V:(22,7),$$
which is already included in the  $c=7$  member of the first event family.Hence the event difference is correct, but the written receipt is not complete: it mentions only the old  $P_0$ -upward event at column  $6$ , while the old  $W$ -downward event must also be recorded. The sentence“There are no other foreign endpoints in  $V$ 's physical endpoint tiles”is also too strong unless “other” is explicitly defined to mean “other unaccounted-for NEW endpoint/event contributions.”A sufficient repair is:Before  $V$ , the  $c=6$  tile already carried both old events  $P_0:(23,6)\to W:(22,6)$  and  $W:(22,6)\to P_0:(23,6)$ . Neither is counted again. After  $V$  is added, the only new event in that tile is  $P_0:(23,7)\to V:(22,7)$ ; the two horizontal  $W/V$  directions and  $V:(22,7)\to P_0:(23,7)$  are support-excluded.Then replace “no other foreign endpoints” with “no other unaccounted NEW foreign endpoints or events.”4. The variable-width and source-phase issue checks outThe first repair really has width  $h+12$ , so its row-23 bar is  $1,\ldots,h+12$ , and
$$q=(23,h+13)$$
is its bar-end support for every even  $h\ge12$ .The second block has  $s_1=-24$ , independent of  $h$ , because the supplied chain constructor updates the shift using the current second-block width  $12$ . Thus the variable first-block width does not introduce the apparent phase collision with  $T$ ; the second repair remains separated from the  $T$  bar in the stated coordinates.5. The forced support and rotor exclusion are validThe point
$$q=(23,h+13)$$
is:a V lateral support;the right bar-end support of  $P_0$ ;absent from the enlarged endpoint union.Its occupied endpoint neighbours are exactly
$$q+(-1,0)=(22,h+13)\in V,
\qquad
q+(0,-1)=(23,h+12)\in P_0.$$
The south and east neighbours are absent.For a new rotor endpoint placed at  $q$ , all of its internal grid-adjacent rotor endpoints must therefore lie in the south/east directions. The rotor's degree-three endpoint positions cannot satisfy this, so only terminal placements remain. Under the eight supplied symmetries, these reduce to the four stated relative pattern classes:the two south-terminal classes contain  $q+(2,1)$ ;one east-terminal class contains  $q+(-1,1)$ ;the other east-terminal class contains  $q+(2,1)$ .The retained root  $K$  contains
$$q+(2,1)=(25,h+14),$$
and  $V$  contains
$$q+(-1,1)=(22,h+14).$$
Thus every rotor placement collides with a retained endpoint. The rotor exclusion is uniform in  $h,g$  and does not require a bounded search.The required revision is therefore local but necessary: complete the  $(22,6)$  old-event ledger and weaken the “no other foreign endpoints” sentence. After that receipt correction, the charge formulas, NEW full/event sets, unbounded  $-h/2-2$  marginal, cumulative  $-h/2-1$  increment, and rotor obstruction are supported for the stated partial-family scope.
